high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a music video playing on a mobile device. The video is titled "Sailor Song" by Gigi Perez. The screen shows the video player interface with various controls such as play/pause, skip forward, shuffle, and repeat buttons. The video itself features a black-and-white illustration. At the top of the illustration, there is text that reads, "AT THE BEACH, IN EVERY LIFE." Below this text, the illustration depicts a lighthouse on the left side, standing tall against a simple background. In front of the lighthouse, there is a silhouette of a person standing on the beach
